original_sentence: During his acceptance speech for the Nobel Peace Prize, Martin Luther King Jr. said, "I believe that unarmed truth and unconditional love will have the final word in reality."
translation: 在诺贝尔和平奖获奖演说中，马丁·路德·金说：“我相信，赤手空拳的真理和无条件的爱将在现实中拥有最终发言权。”

unconditional love 在本句中对应"无条件的爱"。
